# 2. Bar plots (abundance)

## a. Dataset 1 (indiv + host fruits)

```{r}
# 16S
ps_rare_16S_D1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1", "16S_ps_rare_NF_D1.rds"))

# Filter data (exclude fruits ctl & pupal cases)
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S_D1, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "Fruits_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits"))

# Rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits") 

desired_order <- c("Mothers_0days", "Fruits_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days", "Pupae","Daughters")

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)


# ITS
ps_rare_ITS_D1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "Dataset_1", "ITS_ps_rare_NF_D1.rds"))

ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS_D1, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "Fruits_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits"))

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)

# Distinguish "Unknown" families & genus by numbering them with their corresponding cluster number
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- fix_unknown_taxa(phyloseq_object = ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, ranks = c("Family", "Genus"), outfile = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1", "16S_tax_table_rare_expe_D1.tsv"))

ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- fix_unknown_taxa(phyloseq_object = ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, ranks = c("Family", "Genus"), outfile = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1", "ITS_tax_table_rare_expe_D1.tsv"))


## Export
saveRDS(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1",  "ps_16S_rare_expe_D1.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1",  "ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1.rds"))
```

```{r}
## Bar plots : SampleType x FruitType x Site 

# 16S (Family)
plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, "Bacteria", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType+FruitSite, color_16S)

plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases","Daughters")) # reorder 

plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data <-
  plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggsave(filename = "B_Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site.jpg", plot = plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# ITS (Family)
plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, "Fungi", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType+FruitSite, color_ITS) 

plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases","Daughters")) # reorder 

plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data <-
  plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggsave(filename = "Y_Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site.jpg", plot = plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# Combined plot
barPlot_combined <- 
  (plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite + labs(tag = "A. Bacteria")) /
  (plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite + labs(tag = "B. Fungi")) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) & theme(legend.position = "right", plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site_combined.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1", title_plot), barPlot_combined, base_height = 26/cm(1),  base_width = 34.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

# 3. Heatmap (core)

## a. Dataset 1 expe

```{r}
## Load melted data

## 16S
B_dataset_1 = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1) 

B_dataset_1$LifeStage <- factor(B_dataset_1$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
B_dataset_1$FruitType <- factor(B_dataset_1$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

write.table(x=B_dataset_1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition","Dataset_1", "16S_expe_melt_dataset_1.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")

data16S_d1 <- tidyr::as_tibble(read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition","Dataset_1", "16S_expe_melt_dataset_1.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=";"))|>
dplyr::mutate(Marker="16S")


## ITS
Y_dataset_1 = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1) 

Y_dataset_1$LifeStage <- factor(Y_dataset_1$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
Y_dataset_1$FruitType <- factor(Y_dataset_1$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

write.table(x=Y_dataset_1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition","Dataset_1", "ITS_expe_melt_dataset_1.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")

dataITS_d1 <- tidyr::as_tibble(read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition","Dataset_1", "ITS_expe_melt_dataset_1.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=";"))|>
dplyr::mutate(Marker="ITS")


## Join both melted datasets 
data_d1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(data16S_d1, dataITS_d1)
```

```{r}
## Compute frequency

## OTU present or absent
data_d1 <- data_d1 |>
dplyr::mutate(present=dplyr::if_else(Abundance>0, 1, 0))

## Compute frequency per type of sample
freq_data_d1 <- data_d1  |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()|>
  dplyr::mutate(Marker_OTU=paste(Marker, OTU, sep="_"))

## Compute frequency per type of sample and fruit
freq_data_perfruit_d1 <- data_d1 |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, FruitType, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()|>
  dplyr::mutate(Marker_OTU=paste(Marker, OTU, sep="_"))

```

```{r}
## Compute frequency per fruit 

# Compare only samples with life stages available
freq_data_fruit_d1 <- data_d1 |>
dplyr::filter(FruitSiteTypeVariety%in%c("FIN_CH_CDP", "IST_ST_CIF", "LOM_CH_CDP", "MIL_ST_MDB", "VAR_BL_LOC")|SampleType=="Mothers_0days") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, FruitType, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()|>
  dplyr::mutate(Marker_OTU=paste(Marker, OTU, sep="_"))

freq_data_fruit70_d1 <- freq_data_fruit_d1 |>
  dplyr::filter(Frequency>0.7) |>
  tidyr::separate(col = "OTU", into=c(NA, "OTU_ID"), sep="_",
  remove = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(OTU_ID=as.numeric(OTU_ID)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Marker, OTU_ID, FruitType)

OTU5sites_perfruit_d1 <- freq_data_fruit70_d1$Marker_OTU

write.table(x=freq_data_fruit70_d1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1",  "freq_OTU_perfruit_5sites_dataset_1.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Prevalence per fruit type

prevalence_data_fruit_d1 <- freq_data_fruit_d1 |>
    dplyr::filter(Marker_OTU%in%freq_data_fruit70_d1$Marker_OTU)|>
  dplyr::filter(SampleType%in%c("Mothers_0days","Fruits_0days","Fruits_5_6days","Mothers_2days","Larvae","Pupae","PupalCases","Daughters"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(OTUname=paste(Genus, OTU, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(SampleType_Fruit=paste(SampleType, FruitType, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType=paste(FruitType, SampleType, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(SampleType_Fruit_Sample_size=paste0(SampleType_Fruit, " (n=",Sample_size, ")"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=paste0(Fruit_SampleType, " (n=", Sample_size, ")"))|>
  dplyr::select(Marker, OTUname, OTU, SampleType, SampleType_Fruit, Fruit_SampleType, SampleType_Fruit_Sample_size, FruitType, Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size, Frequency)

prevalence_data_fruit_wide_d1 <- prevalence_data_fruit_d1  |>
  dplyr::select(-SampleType) |>
    dplyr::select(-FruitType) |>
  dplyr::select(-Fruit_SampleType) |>
    dplyr::select(-SampleType_Fruit_Sample_size) |>
  dplyr::select(-Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = SampleType_Fruit, values_from = Frequency)

write.table(x=prevalence_data_fruit_wide_d1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1", "prevalence_data_perfruit_5sites_dataset_1.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Relevel Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size

## 16S

## Order we want
lev <- c("Mothers_0days","Fruits_0days","Fruits_5_6days","Mothers_2days","Larvae","Pupae","Daughters")

prevalence_data_fruit16S_d1 <- prevalence_data_fruit_d1 |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker=="16S")|>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=factor(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size))

fact <- levels(prevalence_data_fruit16S_d1$Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size)
## Extract levels in the right order
new_level_order <- fact[grep("na", fact, value = FALSE)]
for (fruit_i in c("BL", "CH", "ST")){
  out <- setNames(sapply(paste(fruit_i,lev, sep="_"), function(x) grep(x, fact, value = FALSE)), lev)
new_level_order <- c(new_level_order, fact[unlist(out)])
}

prevalence_data_fruit16S_d1 <- prevalence_data_fruit16S_d1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=factor(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size, new_level_order))


## ITS

## Order we want
lev <- c("Mothers_0days","Fruits_0days","Fruits_5_6days","Mothers_2days","Larvae","Pupae","Daughters")

prevalence_data_fruitITS_d1 <- prevalence_data_fruit_d1 |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker=="ITS")|>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=factor(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size))

fact <- levels(prevalence_data_fruitITS_d1$Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size)
## Extract levels in the right order
new_level_order <- fact[grep("na", fact, value = FALSE)]
for (fruit_i in c("BL", "CH", "ST")){
  out <- setNames(sapply(paste(fruit_i,lev, sep="_"), function(x) grep(x, fact, value = FALSE)), lev)
new_level_order <- c(new_level_order, fact[unlist(out)])
}

prevalence_data_fruitITS_d1 <- prevalence_data_fruitITS_d1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=factor(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size, new_level_order))
```

```{r}
## Make plot Fruit_SampleType
```

```{r}
## Load melted data

## 16S
B_Dataset_2 = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rare_16S_Dataset_2) 

B_Dataset_2$LifeStage <- factor(B_Dataset_2$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))

write.table(x=B_Dataset_2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition","Dataset_2", "16S_melt_Dataset_2.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")

data16S_d2 <- tidyr::as_tibble(read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition","Dataset_2", "16S_melt_Dataset_2.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=";"))|>
dplyr::mutate(Marker="16S")


## ITS
Y_Dataset_2 = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rare_ITS_Dataset_2) 

Y_Dataset_2$LifeStage <- factor(Y_Dataset_2$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
Y_Dataset_2$FruitType <- factor(Y_Dataset_2$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

write.table(x=Y_Dataset_2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition","Dataset_2", "ITS_melt_Dataset_2.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")

dataITS_d2 <- tidyr::as_tibble(read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition","Dataset_2", "ITS_melt_Dataset_2.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=";"))|>
dplyr::mutate(Marker="ITS")


## Join both melted datasets 
data_d2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(data16S_d2, dataITS_d2)

```

```{r}
## Compute frequency

# OTU present or absent
data_d2 <- data_d2 |>
dplyr::mutate(present=dplyr::if_else(Abundance>0, 1, 0))

# Compute frequency per type of sample
freq_data_d2 <- data_d2  |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()|>
  dplyr::mutate(Marker_OTU=paste(Marker, OTU, sep="_"))


# Compute frequency per type of sample and fruit
freq_data_perfruit_d2 <- data_d2 |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, FruitType, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()|>
  dplyr::mutate(Marker_OTU=paste(Marker, OTU, sep="_"))

```

```{r}
## Taxa per sampletype/fruit

dplyr::filter(SampleType%in%c("Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))

freq_data_fruit70_d2 <- freq_data_fruit_d2 |>
  dplyr::filter(Frequency>0.7) |>

  dplyr::arrange(Marker, OTU_ID, FruitType)
```
